literal: To desire - he who is not experienced - wealth - middle - inside town - poison - tree - having ripened - it is like.
translation: The wealth of a man whom no one loves is like a poisonous tree bearing fruit in the middle of a town.
modern: யாராலும் விரும்பப்படாதவனுடைய செல்வம், ஊரின் நடுவே உள்ள ஒரு நச்சுமரம் பழுத்ததைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares the wealth of an unloved, miserly person to a poisonous tree fruiting in the center of a town. 'நச்சப் படாதவன்' refers to one who is not desired or loved by others, usually because he does not help anyone. Even though his 'செல்வம்' (wealth) is abundant and accessible, like a tree in the 'நடு ஊருள்' (middle of the town), it is utterly useless and even harmful, just as the fruits of a 'நச்சு மரம்' (poisonous tree) cannot be eaten. The wealth benefits no one and only causes sorrow.
